description: A session film: product-ui's measure (320 px wide, a frame is still when under 0.4% of its area moved by more than 8 grey levels, so the camera's creep counts as still), with the end card (the last 1.5 s) left out. The take moves in small ways the measure cannot see: a prompt typed in 18 px type, a spinner while the tool runs, an answer written word by word. Measured on the starter (draft render, wide): 73% still and a longest hold of 3.15 s, the prompt being typed; then 2.7 s as the answer finishes and 2.2 s under the mark. Targets: still at most 85%, hold at most 3.8 s (the 7.5 beats of typing at 123.64 BPM, 3.6 s, and a little), where product-ui allows 70% and 0.85 s. hardCutsMax 0: the window grows out of the full stop and the pill floods into the end card, so nothing is cut (the starter measured 0).
